detail.longDescription: Published v1.0.4 of my GFS/WW3 downloader for XyGrib, straight from NOAA/NOMADS. 🌊 Now builds a combined wind + waves file for a single session. Includes a fix for WW3 swell (surfaceType1=241), which needed patching XyGrib itself. 🔗 Script: https:// github.com/DrCalambre/GFS_NOAA _NOMADS_Downloader_for_XyGrib-72h_GRIB2_Forecast/releases/tag/v1.0.4 🔗 Fork with the fix: https:// github.com/DrCalambre/XyGrib/t ree/fix-swell-241 # XyGrib # GRIB # NOAA # WW3 # sailing # OpenSource
